The lifted meta kwargs now render as real elements

This fixture exercises the five <meta> allowlist members that previously rendered as <span data-enscribe-unknown="…"> for want of vocabulary entries: doi, license, lang, version, keywords. The kwargs lift to child tags at the normalize-to-canonical gate (per the apparatus-tag reconciliation), and now that the vocabulary entries exist, they render as real Layer 1 elements: <doi>, <license>, <lang>, <version>, <keywords>.

A short abstract for the document, included to confirm <abstract> — which was already in the vocabulary, contrary to the backlog claim — continues to render correctly.
